title: Data Lead Engineer - Snowflake
description:
Title: Data Lead Engineer – Snowflake

Location: Remote Mexico/Brazi

Job Type: Contract

Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
Creative Strategist (Direct Response Focus)

Full-Time — Remote**

We’re looking for a Creative Strategist who actually understands direct response , not someone who just scrolls TikTok and assembles trends.

This role is for a strategist who can think in angles, write high-converting copy, break down customer psychology , and work with our editors/designers to produce winning ad variations across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.

If your background is influencer-style content creation — this is NOT for you.

If your background is direct response, performance marketing, hooks, messaging frameworks, and ad psychology — we want you.

What You’ll Do
  • Develop direct-response creative strategies for eCommerce and local brands (UGC, statics, VSLs, long-form ads).
  • Write strong hooks, scripts, headlines, and CTAs rooted in psychology — not fluff.
  • Analyze data and identify what’s working, what’s not, and why.
  • Build clear creative briefs for editors, designers, and UGC creators.
  • Collaborate with the growth team to refine angles, offers, and messaging frameworks.
  • Turn raw ideas, calls, client notes, and problems into high-performing creative concepts .
  • (Bonus) Oversee or contribute to production/filming direction if you have that background.
  • Maintain a high output of strategic ideas and creative testing concepts weekly.
What You MUST Bring
  • Direct response experience — you know what makes an ad convert, not just “look cool.”
  • Strong copywriting ability (hooks, headlines, scripts, micro-copy).
  • Ability to translate product benefits into angles, stories, emotional triggers, and offers .
  • Experience working with paid media teams or creatives in a performance-focused environment.
  • Strong understanding of Meta/TikTok best practices.
  • Analytical mindset — you can look at data and form a hypothesis instantly.
  • Creative volume — you can generate 10 concepts where others generate 2.
  • Excellent communication and clarity inside creative briefs.
Bonus Points
  • Production or directing experience
  • Understanding of UGC scripting
  • Experience with DTC brands (beauty, wellness, fashion, home goods, jewelry, etc.)
  • Can storyboard fast and collaborate closely with editors
Who You Are
  • You think like a marketer , not an influencer.
  • You write copy that hits where it hurts — and inspires action.
  • You’re obsessed with performance, not aesthetics.
  • You’re fast, resourceful, and comfortable producing a high volume of ideas.
  • You thrive in an environment with speed, iteration, and testing.
  • You can take a product, research it deeply, and build a messaging system around it.
Why Join Us
  • Work with a fast-growing performance agency scaling 7–8 figure brands.

  • Clear processes, creative pipelines, and a supportive production team.
  • High impact role — your work directly influences revenue.
  • Opportunities for growth into Creative Lead roles.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
About the Company

This company operates a global computing platform that enables businesses to programmatically deploy single-tenant Bare Metal instances across multiple regions worldwide.

They are a team of passionate engineers working at the intersection of hardware, software, and network infrastructure, building the fastest, most developer-centric single-tenant cloud infrastructure on the market. If you share this passion, this role offers the opportunity to help shape the future of internet-scale infrastructure.

This position is being managed in partnership with an external recruitment consultancy supporting the company throughout the hiring process.

Summary

The Reliability team is responsible for the health and resilience of the infrastructure powering a global bare metal cloud platform. As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) , you'll focus on building reliable, observable, and self-healing systems at scale.

SREs here operate at the intersection of software engineering and infrastructure — designing tools that automate operations, improve incident response, and enhance observability, ensuring the platform delivers high performance and reliability to customers worldwide.

This role is ideal for engineers passionate about reliability, automation, distributed systems, and bringing cloud-like experiences to bare metal environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Continuously improve platform reliability and performance.

  • Develop and document operational playbooks and processes.

Required:

  • Proficiency with IaC tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible)

  • Proficiency with scripting/programming languages such as Bash, Python, Go, or Ruby

title: English Language Specialist
description:
iMerit seeks detail-oriented and analytically minded Multimodal GenAI Evaluation Analysts to perform highly nuanced evaluations of AI system outputs across different modalities: text, image, video, and multimodal interactions. Analysts will assess the accuracy, appropriateness, quality, clarity, and cultural alignment of model outputs against complex guidelines, ensuring that results align with project standards and real-world use cases. These evaluations will directly inform the development and fine-tuning of advanced large language models (LLMs), vision models (LVMs), and multimodal AI systems.

Role Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate outputs generated by LLMs across multiple modalities (text, image captions, video descriptions, and multimodal prompts).
  • Assess quality against project-specific criteria such as correctness, coherence, completeness, style, cultural appropriateness, and safety.
  • Identify subtle errors, hallucinations, or biases in AI responses.
  • Apply domain expertise and logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous or unclear outputs.
  • Provide detailed written feedback, tagging, and scoring of outputs to ensure consistency across the evaluation team.
  • Escalate unclear cases and contribute to refining evaluation guidelines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Quality Leads to meet accuracy, reliability, and turnaround benchmarks.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong critical reading, observational, and evaluative skills across different modalities.
  • Ability to articulate nuanced judgments with precision and clarity.
  • Excellent English comprehension (CEFR B2 or above); additional languages a plus.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, and multimodal systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to apply guidelines consistently.
  • Awareness of cultural and linguistic nuances, including potential bias and harm in AI outputs.
  • Comfort with evolving workflows, rapid feedback cycles, and complex quality frameworks.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification.
  • 1+ years of experience in data annotation, LLM evaluation, content moderation, or related AI/ML domains.
  • Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms.
  • Strong understanding of language and multimodal communication (instruction following in image generation, fact-checking, narrative coherence in video, etc.).
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments.
  • Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Prior exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering, or LLM fine-tuning workflows is a plus.

While moderation of high-harm/high-risk material is not part of this role, candidates should be aware that occasional exposure to NSFW or otherwise sensitive content may occur due to imperfections in client-provided datasets. Applicants should indicate that they are comfortable working in environments where such incidental exposure is a possibility.

What We Offer:

  • Opportunities to shape the evaluation standards for next-generation multimodal AI systems.
  • Innovative and supportive global working environment.
  • Competitive compensation and flexible remote working arrangements.
  • Continuous learning and growth in applied AI evaluation.

Join iMerit to help shape the benchmarks and standards that ensure AI systems are accurate, safe, and culturally aware across text, vision, and multimodal applications. If rigorous analysis and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

Nosso objetivo é que você seja formado para atuar como um Planejador Financeiro, levando tranquilidade financeira para todos os brasileiros.

title: Performance Tracking & Tag Management Specialist (LATAM) — Remote
description:
Join GrowthAssistant as a Performance Tracking & Tag Management Specialist!

Open to candidates from LATAM countries only (e.g., Mexico, Brazil, Colombia)

About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Performance Tracking & Tag Management Specialist to support our client’s Paid Media team. You’ll ensure every digital advertising campaign is tracked accurately and consistently, building and maintaining the infrastructure behind performance measurement. This includes configuring, QA’ing, and troubleshooting tracking systems—mainly via Google Tag Manager (GTM)—to ensure data integrity and accurate attribution.

By partnering closely with Paid Search Specialists and Account Strategists, you’ll help eliminate inaccurate conversion data, improve ROI reporting, and enable smarter optimization decisions across 60+ client accounts.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Implement, QA, and maintain tags, triggers, and pixels in Google Tag Manager (GTM) across client websites.
  • Audit and troubleshoot conversion tracking configurations across platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads, Bing Ads).
  • Validate conversion actions to ensure form fills, purchases, or other lead events are correctly recorded, avoiding inflated reporting.
  • Standardize and document tagging schemas for all client accounts in Salesforce, ensuring consistent fields (budget, KPIs, goals, tracking status).
  • Partner with Paid Search Specialists to align conversion actions and budgets with each client’s true business objectives.
  • Create and maintain a tracking QA checklist and intake form to guide new account setups and audits.
  • Perform ongoing health checks of all tracking infrastructure to proactively identify broken tags or discrepancies.
  • Collaborate with the client’s marketing team to recommend scalable intake and QA processes (e.g., onboarding forms, Salesforce automation).
  • Produce clear documentation for all tagging and data validation processes to ensure team-wide continuity.

What We’re Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience managing Google Tag Manager (tag creation, testing, triggers, version control).
  • Solid understanding of conversion tracking across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other paid media platforms.
  • Hands-on experience validating data layers, debugging tags, and testing event triggers in browser consoles.
  • Strong ability to QA campaign tracking and identify discrepancies between actual and reported performance data.
  • Demonstrated experience creating or maintaining documentation (SOPs, QA templates, checklists).
  • Excellent communication skills to partner with account managers, strategists, and technical teams.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Familiarity with Salesforce or other CRM systems for marketing data management.
  • Understanding of enhanced conversions, consent mode, and privacy-related tagging.
  • Exposure to GA4 or other analytics platforms for event-based measurement.
  • Experience supporting agencies managing high-volume client portfolios.
  • Prior experience collaborating with web developers or marketing analysts on data validation and tag troubleshooting.

Durable Skills

  • Highly detail-oriented, precise, and methodical in QA and documentation.
  • Process-driven mindset—capable of building repeatable tagging and validation frameworks.
  • Problem-solving mentality with a focus on scalable solutions.
  • Strong collaboration and communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ownership mentality with a focus on accuracy, quality, and reliability.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At GrowthAssistant, you’ll collaborate with a diverse, talented team, sharpen your skills with global clients, and make an impact in your career. We value your growth and recognize your contributions every step of the way.

Apply today and take the next step in your career with GrowthAssistant!

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
Position Summary:

Our partner, a growing streaming and marketing optimization product company, is looking to add a BI Analyst to its team. In this role, your focus will be on analyzing operational business data and transforming it into meaningful insights and actionable strategies. title: Consultor de Vendas - On Trade São Paulo
description:
Sobre Nós (A Cultura Zahil)

Somos uma referência consolidada de 39 anos no mercado brasileiro na importação e distribuição de vinhos. Nosso portfólio possui mais de 400 rótulos de 70 produtores de 15 países, presentes em mais de 4.000 pontos de venda em todo o país. Acreditamos que o vinho é capaz de conectar pessoas e criar momentos únicos.

O Perfil que Buscamos

Você é uma pessoa naturalmente curiosa e orientada a resultados , que enxerga cada negócio como uma oportunidade de construir uma parceria duradoura. Tem a maturidade para trabalhar com autonomia , gerir sua carteira de clientes e a criatividade para inovar dentro de um ambiente que valoriza tanto a tradição quanto a evolução.

Características que nos inspiram:

  • Mentalidade analítica: Usa dados para fundamentar decisões criativas e montar cartas de vinho estratégicas.
  • Visão estratégica: Enxerga o panorama completo (cliente, mercado, concorrência) antes de agir.
  • Adaptabilidade: Aprende rapidamente e se reinventa conforme as necessidades do mercado e dos clientes.
  • Proatividade: Antecipa necessidades (do restaurante, do hotel) e propõe soluções de portfólio e serviço.
  • Resiliência: Transforma os desafios da negociação e do dia a dia em oportunidades de crescimento.

Descrição do Cargo

O(A) Consultor(a) de Vendas On-Trade é uma peça-chave na estratégia da Zahil em São Paulo. Ele(a) é responsável por construir e gerenciar relacionamentos com os principais restaurantes, hotéis, bares e casas de eventos da cidade. A função exige uma prospecção ativa e uma gestão de carteira inteligente, transformando o portfólio Zahil em cartas de vinhos vencedoras e rentáveis para nossos parceiros.

É preciso agilidade para navegar no dinâmico mercado de restaurantes de São Paulo. Flexibilidade, capacidade de improvisação e vontade de aprender constantemente. O objetivo é ser um parceiro estratégico para o cliente (o dono do restaurante, o sommelier, o gerente de A&B), garantindo visibilidade, treinamento da brigada e o crescimento mútuo.

Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar uma carteira de clientes On-Trade (restaurantes, hotéis, bares) em São Paulo, fortalecendo o relacionamento e identificando oportunidades.
  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com perfil estratégico para o portfólio Zahil.
  • Analisar as cartas de vinho dos clientes e apresentar os rótulos Zahil que possam se destacar e fazer a diferença, considerando harmonização, "pricing" e perfil do estabelecimento.
  • Negociar a inclusão de novos rótulos, ações de visibilidade (ex: vinho em taça, "wine dinners") e condições comerciais.
  • Organizar e executar treinamentos para a brigada (equipe de salão, sommeliers) dos clientes, focando no conhecimento do produto e em técnicas para impulsionar o "sell-out".
  • Acompanhar o desempenho dos clientes (volume, mix de produtos) e propor ações para atingir as metas.
  • Transmitir à gerência as dificuldades, demandas do mercado (concorrência, preços) e oportunidades que ultrapassem sua autonomia.
  • Manter o time comercial informado sobre todas as atuações e comunicações da Zahil, chegada de produtos, mudanças de preços e promoções.
  • Apoiar no uso dos sistemas internos de CRM (para gestão do funil) e de faturamento (para colocação de pedidos).

Qualificações e Experiência

  • Escolaridade: Desejável graduação completa.
  • Cursos: Curso de vinhos técnico ou de extensão (WSET, ABS, etc.) é fundamental.
  • Idiomas: Desejável inglês ou espanhol
  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de três anos em vendas B2B, com experiência comprovada no canal On-Trade de bebidas (especialmente vinhos).
  • Networking: Um relacionamento ativo e uma carteira pré-existente com sommeliers, donos de restaurantes e gerentes de A&B em São Paulo será um grande diferencial.
  • Habilidades: Forte capacidade de negociação, comunicação, organização e perfil "hunter" (caçador).

Remuneração:

  • Regime CLT: R$ 3.000,00 (três mil reais) de salário fixo + comissão mensal
  • Benefícios: Vale Refeição/Alimentação, Vale Mobilidade e Plano médico Unimed

title: Lead WordPress Developer
description:
About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.

The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.

You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.

Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data

HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy

Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges

Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed

Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles

Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members

Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning

Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you'll be working closely with team members across time zones.

Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We're building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.

title: Front End AI Engineer
description:
Position Overview:

We are seeking a Front End AI Engineer with deep expertise in building high-quality, production-ready interfaces for AI-powered applications. This role focuses on leading the front-end architecture for advanced AI systems, including conversational interfaces, agent control panels, automation dashboards, and embedded AI workflows for client deployments. The ideal candidate is fluent in modern React, highly skilled in TypeScript, comfortable working across design systems, and efficient with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code.

This is a senior-level role where you will serve as the point person for all front-end initiatives across multiple client projects. You will collaborate closely with our AI, automation, and product teams to translate complex agentic and generative AI capabilities into intuitive, reliable, and high-performance user experiences.

Key Responsibilities:

Front End Architecture and Development

  • Own the front-end strategy and implementation for AI-powered products and interfaces.
  • Build high-quality React applications using TypeScript, modular component architectures, and modern state management patterns.
  • Experience with design and Figma.
  • Use AI-enhanced development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to accelerate development, improve quality, and maintain consistency across projects.
  • Design reusable component libraries tailored for AI interfaces, including chat interfaces, agent dashboards, workflow builders, analytics panels, and data visualization.
  • Ensure UX clarity when surfacing complex AI behavior, including agent states, reasoning paths, confidence indicators, and human-in-the-loop controls.
  • Coordinate with the backend and AI engineering teams to integrate REST APIs, WebSockets, vector search endpoints, automation pipelines, and generative model outputs.
  • Lead code reviews, establish front-end standards, and mentor engineers on best practices in AI-driven front-end development.

AI Interface Development

  • Build highly responsive conversational UI components for voice and text-based agents.
  • Develop systems to visualize agentic operations, multi-step workflows, and tool usage.
  • Implement secure user authentication and permissions for client-facing AI dashboards.
  • Work with designers to translate conceptual AI workflows into intuitive user flows and polished UI.
  • Collaborate with the AI engineering team to improve prompt workflows, data capture, and human override safety controls from the front-end layer.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary owner and technical authority for front-end delivery across all AI engagements.
  • Work closely with product managers, designers, AI engineers, and automation specialists to define scope and translate requirements into clear front-end plans.
  • Help clients understand interface possibilities and guide them toward the most effective implementation strategies.
  • Ensure that front-end systems meet client needs around reliability, accessibility, and performance.

Qualifications:

Required

  • 5+ years of professional experience as a front-end engineer.
  • Expert-level proficiency in React and TypeScript.
  • Design experience and using tools like Figma.
  • Demonstrated experience owning complex front-end applications from architecture through deployment.
  • Comfortable with AI-enhanced coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, and related platforms.
  • Familiarity with building AI-enabled interfaces, including chat UIs, real-time dashboards, visual workflows, or similar components.
  • Strong experience with API integration, authentication, and state management patterns.
  • Ability to work independently, set technical direction, and mentor less experienced developers.
  • Strong UX instincts and the ability to translate technical AI functionality into clear and usable interfaces.

Preferred

  • Experience building interfaces for LLM-powered systems, automation workflows, or agent-based applications.
  • Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, or retrieval augmented UIs.
  • Experience with streaming updates, event-driven front-end patterns, or real-time systems.
  • Background in building interfaces for enterprise clients or complex operational environments.
  • Experience collaborating with AI engineers on prompt workflows and agent control features.

Work Environment and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation structure with performance incentives.
  • Flexible remote or hybrid work environment.
  • Opportunity to shape the front-end architecture for cutting-edge AI systems across multiple industries.
  • High-impact work with clients committed to modernization and operational transformation.

title: On-Site IT Support Engineer
description:
Overview

We are looking for a dedicated and proactive On-Site IT Support Engineer to provide hands-on support for our local infrastructure, users, and critical systems. This role ensures smooth IT operations, continuity of services, and timely resolution of incidents during the designated support period. The engineer will serve as the primary point of contact for IT-related issues at the site, while also performing preventive maintenance and ensuring system stability.

Key Responsibilities

Scope of Work / Activities to be Covered

  • Provide on-site support for resolving technical incidents related to infrastructure, systems, and end-user devices.
  • Perform monitoring of IT equipment and infrastructure maintenance , ensuring uptime and reliability.
  • Offer desktop/user support for local staff, including troubleshooting hardware, software, and connectivity issues.
  • Conduct preventive maintenance activities such as security checks, system health checks, and patch updates.
  • Monitor and coordinate critical service requests with remote teams and vendors as needed.
  • Assist in escalating complex incidents to higher-level support teams while ensuring proper follow-through.

Expected Results

  • Operational Continuity Maintenance: Ensure that business processes and local operations remain unaffected during the support period.
  • Quality of Service: Deliver efficient, timely, and professional IT support with effective problem-solving skills.
  • Reliable Technical Support: Minimize downtime and interruptions across IT systems and infrastructure.
  • Documentation and Reporting: Prepare and submit clear incident logs, resolution details, and preventive maintenance reports for transparency and accountability.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Proven experience in IT support, helpdesk, or desktop engineering roles .
  • Strong knowledge of Windows/Mac operating systems, networking basics, hardware, and peripherals .
  • Familiarity with ITSM ticketing systems and incident management processes.
  • Ability to conduct preventive maintenance and security checks .
  • Strong communication skills and ability to interact with end-users at all levels.
  • Detail-oriented with strong documentation and reporting skills.
  • Professional certifications (CompTIA A+, Network+, ITIL, or Microsoft/CCNA) are a plus.

title: Territory Manager
description:
XPEL, Inc. (NASDAQ: XPEL), a leading supplier of automotive paint protection films, window films, ceramic coatings, and commercial/residential flat glass films, is currently seeking a Territory Manager for the Southern Brazil region (Porto Alegre/Florianópolis/Curitiba)

Resumo da Vaga:

O Territory Manager será responsável pelas vendas gerais dos produtos XPEL em sua área de atuação.

Esse profissional atuará tanto com concessionárias quanto com instaladores independentes, ou em uma combinação de ambos, dependendo do potencial do mercado local.

O mercado automotivo contemplado inclui o segmento de pós-venda automotivo (aftermarket) — abrangendo instaladores de películas automotivas (window fims, PPF), studios de detalhamento automotivo, franquias e instaladores profissionais independentes — além de novas concessionárias de veículos.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Gerir e expandir as vendas no território designado, com foco em atingir ou superar as metas de crescimento.
  • Atuar de forma ativa em vendas, estando em campo cerca de 50% do tempo com clientes atuais e potenciais.
  • Manter e aprimorar a satisfação dos clientes, oferecendo um serviço excepcional e construindo relacionamentos de longo prazo.
  • Monitorar e analisar o uso dos produtos pelos clientes, identificando oportunidades para introdução de novos produtos e maximização de receita.
  • Gerenciar e desenvolver relacionamentos comerciais, fornecendo relatórios gerenciais regulares conforme necessário.
  • Ser o principal ponto de contato com os clientes, garantindo comunicação e suporte eficazes por meio de diversos canais (e-mail, telefone, apresentações online, compartilhamento de tela e reuniões presenciais).
  • Realizar análises de mercado e desenvolver estratégias de aquisição e conquista de novos clientes.
  • Fazer o follow-up de leads de vendas, colaborando com a equipe de Administração de Vendas para garantir a integração e onboarding eficiente de novos clientes.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os Gerentes de Loja e Instaladores Chefes, assegurando a perfeita coordenação entre as áreas de vendas e operações.
  • Prospectar novas oportunidades de crescimento, criando iniciativas estratégicas e ações proativas.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências e inovações do setor automotivo, participando de treinamentos internos, lendo publicações especializadas e ampliando sua rede de contatos profissionais.

Qualificações Necessárias:

  • Formação superior em Administração, Marketing ou áreas correlatas (ou experiência equivalente).
  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência profissional em vendas, com histórico comprovado de resultados.
  • Perfil proativo, altamente motivado e organizado.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, relacionamento interpessoal, análise e resolução de problemas.
  • Forte capacidade de negociação e gestão de relacionamento com clientes.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens (cerca de 50%).
  • Carteira de habilitação válida, com histórico de direção limpo.
  • Residência dentro do território designado.
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões adequadas, com foco em atendimento ao cliente, segurança e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Domínio do Pacote Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).

title: Culinary Instructor
description:
Key Responsibilities :

1 Culinary Training & Development :

◦ Develop and execute the ship’s overall Culinary Training & Development strategy for all Culinary crew members with 2 or fewer stripes.

◦ Ensure understanding and delivery of the company’s service standards, training materials, operational practices, and rating systems for the Culinary Department.

◦ Conduct relevant training and follow-up audits to ensure these standards are being met consistently.

2 Collaboration with Senior Culinary Leadership :

◦ Assist the Executive Chef and Executive Sous Chef in identifying crew members with the potential for career advancement.

◦ Collaborate with leadership to evaluate crew members who may not meet the required skill set or attitude and determine their future role within the team.

3 Coaching & Staff Development :

◦ Provide ongoing training on company standards and best practices to all culinary employees.

◦ Conduct role-play sessions and hands-on training for crew members at their respective workstations.

◦ Offer constructive feedback during coaching sessions and performance audits.

4 Training Scheduling & Reporting :

◦ Create daily training schedules and feedback reports, presenting them to the Executive Chef.

◦ Organize and execute daily daytime training sessions (45 minutes per group) for crew members on port days, ensuring relevant performance, revenue, and ratings data inform participant selection.

◦ Conduct nightly follow-up performance audits and provide feedback to the crew members and the Executive Chef.

5 Performance Audits & One-on-One Coaching :

◦ Conduct performance audits and coaching sessions during sea days, providing feedback to both crew members and management.

◦ Identify low performers and work with the Executive Chef to create improvement plans for those who may require additional training or support.

6 Mentorship for Senior Staff :

◦ Coach and mentor Chef de Cuisine, Sous Chefs, and Chef de Partie on effectively conducting training sessions, including facility setup, session flow, feedback delivery, and session evaluation.

Qualifications:

Candidate should work as a culinary teacher or instructor in a culinary academy or institute.

Strong background in training and development, teaching, and communications.

Possesses culinary expertise, formal education, and practical experience in the culinary field.

Having culinary training and certificates is a plus.

description:
RESUMO DA DESCRIÇÃO DO CARGO:

Mapear as jornadas dos pacientes, do tratamento, da prescrição, do acesso dentro das instituições. Promover à classe médica, informações cientificas dos nossos produtos; elaborar e implementar planos de ação do território, alinhado com as estratégias de Marketing, visando atingir as metas de demanda e vendas. PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

Garantir a qualidade do cadastro médico através de segmentação e conhecimento dos perfis profissionais médicos e multidisciplinares; assegurar a cobertura de visitação médica dentro dos critérios mínimos dos KPIs estabelecidos pela companhia.

Planejar o trabalho diário visando otimizar o tempo disponível e aplicá-lo em ações que revertam em resultados.

Analisar as auditorias de mercado, identificando oportunidades de crescimentos para construção e implementação dos Plano de Ação do Território.

Identificar oportunidades de novos negócios, servindo de modelo para os demais CTs.

Alcançar as metas de demandas das Marcas no território, gerando impacto positivo no resultado das vendas da Unidade de Negócio.

Verbas / investimentos - Propor plano de investimento baseado numa análise do setor de atuação, gerenciando os recursos de forma efetiva.

Aprimorar e ampliar o seu conhecimento técnico relacionado aos nossos produtos e concorrentes, atingindo nível de excelência e sendo referência para os demais colegas.

Promover e participar de eventos médicos ligados a sua área de atuação, planejando e executando as atividades, mini meetings e os eventos científicos do setor de acordo com a estratégia de cada marca.

Construir relacionamento ético com médicos-chave, Sociedades Médicas, Centros de Referência e Secretarias de Saúde dentro do setor, visitando-os periodicamente.

Acompanhar ativamente a jornada dos pacientes, processos de padronização e performance de vendas de nossos produtos nos principais hospitais, clínicas e Secretarias de Saúde, atuando em conjunto com o time Cross Function (KAM, SAM, MKT, Acesso, Medical etc) no conceito e entendimento de Gestão de Conta Caves visando alcançar as melhores performances em demanda e vendas dos produtos OLE.

Manter-se atualizado e informar o Gerente Distrital e demais áreas sobre as tendências de mercado, produtos, ações da concorrência, padronizações e outros fatores que poderão influenciar ou ter impacto em seus resultados.

Entender e implementar as estratégias da Adium de acordo com o plano tático estabelecido, adaptando-o ao perfil da região de atuação e as necessidades dos clientes; gerar feedbacks constantes para o marketing, acesso público e privado, KAMs e área médica com sugestões de eventuais ajustes nas mensagens e/ou dados.

Identificar ações que levem soluções aos pacientes, às instituições e médicos da sua região, gerando relacionamento sustentável com os clientes.

Ser pró-ativo em iniciativas na equipe e fora dela, para aumentar o nível de conhecimento técnico e preparo para promoção, trazendo ideias e sugestões de melhoria para produtividade do campo e para demais áreas.

Mapear todos os stakeholders das contas chaves e garantir a atualização na ferramenta Veeva.

Conhecer os fluxos e processos de liberação e reembolso de medicamentos, tanto nas instituições privadas como públicas (ex: APACs e LMEs)

Conhecer o mercado de oncologia (dentro de sua linha de atuação), protocolos, portarias, políticas de reembolso público e privado e estudos de Farmacoeconomia para suportar a implementação das estratégias de vendas.

title: Security Software Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)

Please upload your CV Resume in English.

Monthly salary: $6,000 USD

Along with our partner, we are seeking a security-conscious contract Senior level Software Engineer to help enhance the security posture of their applications. The primary focus of this role is to systematically reduce their attack surface by addressing high-priority security risks. Using Snyk as the primary scanning tool, this engineer will be responsible for identifying, prioritizing, and remediating dependencies with known exploitable vulnerabilities. The goal is a targeted reduction of risk, not a simple "update-all" approach.

Role & Responsibilities:

The engineer will be responsible for the following:

  • Vulnerability Analysis:  Analyze the results of Snyk scans of their codebases (Ruby, Go, Python, JavaScript).
  • Prioritization: Critically assess Snyk reports to distinguish between theoretical vulnerabilities and those that are genuinely exploitable within the context of their applications.
  • Targeted Remediation:  Plan and execute targeted dependency upgrades or apply patches specifically to fix the prioritized exploitable vulnerabilities, ensuring minimal disruption to the system.
  • Code & Test Validation: Refactor code and update unit/integration tests as necessary to support the upgraded dependencies and validate the fixes.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Work closely with internal security and engineering teams, participate in code reviews, and clearly document the rationale for each remediation.

Required Skills & Qualifications (Must-Haves):

Candidates must have demonstrable, hands-on experience in the following areas:

  • Security Tooling:  Proven professional experience using  Snyk to identify, prioritize, and manage vulnerabilities in a production environment. Candidate must be able to interpret Snyk's findings, including exploit maturity and reachability.
  • Strong professional experience with all of the following languages:

○ Ruby (including Ruby on Rails)

○ Go

○ Python

○ JavaScript

○ TypeScript

  • Deep expertise with package managers for each ecosystem (e.g., package.json, Go Modules, Pip/Poetry, NPM/Yarn).
  • Version Control:  Expert-level proficiency with Git.
  • Automated Testing:  A strong commitment to quality with proven experience in writing comprehensive tests.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Haves):

While not mandatory, preference will be given to candidates with experience in:

  • Other Security Tools:  Familiarity with other SAST/SCA tools (e.g., GitHub Advanced Security, Checkmarx, Trivy).
  • CI/CD Integration:  Experience integrating security tools like Snyk into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
  • Containerization:  Experience with Docker and container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes).

Benefits:

  • A fully remote position, allowing for work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to be a part of a mission-driven company that is committed to taking care of its employees.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year
  • 10 paid days for local holidays

Work Schedule : US Eastern Standard Time

*Please note this role is currently for a 3-month project with the potential for a long-term position.

title: Complex Investigations Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 65+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for an Intelligence Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on complex investigations (AML, sanctions, and organised fraud).

You'll act as the core investigative expert for the Brazilian market, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and conduct deep-dive analyses.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you'll be doing

  • Conducting in-depth, intelligence-led investigations into high-risk money laundering, sanctions, fraud, and organised crime cases involving customers in Brazil
  • Identifying emerging ML/TF typologies across PIX, credit, retail, and business products, translating findings into actionable insights and control enhancements
  • Ensuring timely and accurate reporting to COAF and supporting MLROs with defensible SAR narratives and documentation aligned with BCB requirements
  • Escalating systemic gaps identified through investigations, raising risk incidents, and coordinating remediation with FinCrime Product and Data teams
  • Contributing to FinCrime governance forums (CRC, ERC, ExCo), providing data-backed updates on investigations, risk trends, and control effectiveness
  • Acting as an interface between CIU, global FIU, compliance assurance, and external regulators during inspections or information requests

What you'll need

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex AML and fraud investigations within a financial institution or fintech, including exposure to layering, scams, synthetic identities, and organised crime
  • A solid understanding of BCB and COAF frameworks, including SAR requirements, sanctions, and fraud-reporting obligations
  • Experience identifying systemic gaps, raising risk incidents, and designing remediation plans across AML and fraud controls
  • Expertise in reading and interpreting transaction data (PIX, credit, card, business), using Looker, SQL, or equivalent tools to detect typologies and outliers
  • The ability to prepare clear, defensible reports and narratives for regulatory filings and internal governance forums
  • To be able to explain complex AML/fraud findings to non-technical audiences, senior management, and regulators

Nice to have

  • The ability to perform deep data exploration using SQL, Python, or visualisation tools (Looker, Power BI) to detect typologies or anomalies
  • Confidence presenting findings, risk summaries, and recommendations to senior management, committees, or regulators
  • An interest in coaching junior investigators and supporting FinCrime capability growth in Brazil
  • Prior exposure to regulatory inspections or audits, including BCB or internal audit follow-ups, with experience presenting control evidence

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Tecnico de Campo Jr (Triangulo Mineiro)
description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. Our critical communications, video security and command center technologies support public safety agencies and enterprises alike, enabling the coordination that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals and safer businesses. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

Nossa missão é ser a garantia física de que nossos sistemas de comunicação de missão crítica – que apoiam segurança pública, grandes empresas e serviços essenciais – estejam sempre operacionais e com cobertura máxima. Job Description

Buscamos um(a) Técnico(a) de Campo Júnior proativo(a) e dedicado(a) para integrar nossa equipe no Triangulo Mineiro/MG, atuando na instalação, configuração e manutenção de sistemas de comunicação de missão crítica (RF e Rádio Enlace). Este profissional será essencial para garantir a excelência operacional e a satisfação do cliente na região, com alta disponibilidade para viagens a trabalho.

O Técnico de Campo Júnior será responsável por:

  • Instalação e Configuração:

Realizar a instalação e substituição de partes, peças e módulos em equipamentos de telecomunicações.

Configurar e parametrizar rádios móveis e portáteis nos padrões de comunicação da empresa.

Implementar e configurar equipamentos de Rádio Frequência (RF), incluindo sistemas de Rádio Enlace (Transmissão) e infraestrutura associada.

  • Manutenção e Suporte:

Executar rotinas de Manutenção Corretiva e Preventiva em sistemas de comunicação (RF e infraestrutura).

Garantir o suporte técnico de campo de alta qualidade, interagindo diretamente com o cliente e resolvendo falhas.

Conduzir o tratamento de chamados, realizando a interface técnica e o escalonamento necessário junto ao NOC (Network Operations Center).

  • Documentação e Qualidade:

Elaborar relatórios técnicos detalhados e precisos dos atendimentos, manutenções e instalações realizadas (incluindo As-Built).

Seguir rigorosamente as normas e procedimentos de segurança (NR-10 e NR-35) e os padrões de qualidade da Empresa’s

Basic Requirements

Formação e Certificação:

  • Base: Residir em Uberaba/MG ou região
  • Formação Técnica: Eletrotécnica, Eletrônica, Telecomunicações ou Elétrica.
  • Registro Profissional: Situação regular junto ao CFT (Conselho Federal dos Técnicos Industriais).

Experiência Técnica:

  • Experiência prévia em suporte técnico de campo ou implementação de sistemas de Rádio Frequência (RF).
  • Experiência prática na instalação e configuração de rádios de comunicação (fixos, móveis ou portáteis).
  • Conhecimento básico em infraestrutura de Telecomunicações, incluindo sítios (sites) de RF e torres.

Segurança e Mobilidade:

  • Trabalho em Altura: Experiência em serviços que exigem trabalho em altura e Certificação NR-35 válida.
  • Segurança Elétrica: Conhecimento e Certificação NR-10 válida (Segurança em Instalações e Serviços com Eletricidade).
  • Disponibilidade para Viagens (50%): Alta mobilidade para atendimento na região e estado.
  • Habilitação: CNH válida (Categoria B).

Requisitos Desejáveis (Diferenciais)

  • Padrões de Comunicação: Conhecimento e familiaridade com padrões como TETRA, APCO25 e/ou DMR.
  • Rádio Enlace: Conhecimento prático em instalação e configuração de equipamentos de Rádio Enlace (Links de Transmissão).
  • Redes IP: Conhecimentos sólidos em Redes IP (Camada 2/3) e habilidades de troubleshooting (identificação e resolução de problemas de rede).
  • Idiomas: Inglês - Nível básico para leitura de manuais técnicos e comunicação escrita.
  • Ferramentas: Proficiência em Pacote Office (Word, Excel) e Google Tools (Docs, Sheets).

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

description:
Team Lead – Enterprise Networking (Service Provider)

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Team Lead – Enterprise Networking to support a key RPS account, driving delivery excellence across Enterprise, Wireless, Data Center, Security, and Service Provider technologies. The ideal candidate brings strong technical depth, customer-facing ability, and hands-on experience with Cisco solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead design, deployment, and troubleshooting across multi-domain Cisco networking environments.
  • Provide technical guidance to engineers and serve as a primary escalation point.
  • Deliver high-quality architecture reviews, workshops, and solution recommendations.
  • Coordinate with customer stakeholders and internal teams to ensure successful project execution.
  • Prepare documentation (HLD/LLD), test plans, and operational runbooks.

Required Skills

  • Strong knowledge of routing & switching (OSPF, BGP, STP, VLAN, LACP, VXLAN-EVPN).
  • Experience with Cisco Wireless (WLC, APs, CMX, Prime), Enterprise Switching, and ISR/ASR platforms.
  • Understanding of DC technologies (Nexus, ACI, FabricPath, FEX, VXLAN).
  • Exposure to Cisco Security products (ASA, FTD, ISE, VPNs, AAA).
  • Good understanding of IP/MPLS, L2/L3 VPNs, EVPN, and SP architectures.
  • Excellent communication and customer-facing skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience delivering customer workshops and network design engagements.
  • Familiarity with SDA, SD-WAN, ACI, Cloud Networking, and automation (Python/Ansible).

title: Gerente de Vendas | Jardim Pirituba

Falar da MRV&CO é dizer muito mais do que ser os títulos que recebemos durante nossa história de 46 anos. Ser a maior construtora da América Latina nos orgulha muito. Mas não só isso!   • Formação superior completa ou cursando;

Mais do que casas, queremos construir respostas. Já somos mais de 30 mil colaboradores diretos e indiretos, engajados na busca por um futuro melhor para todos e todas.

Estamos em mais de 160 cidades pelo Brasil e em 22 cidades dos EUA, de portas abertas para receber quem quiser fazer parte deste crescimento.

Acreditamos que diversidade e inclusão são componentes essenciais para o crescimento da sociedade, além de serem fatores essenciais para a sustentabilidade do nosso negócio.

Queremos estimular um ambiente seguro, diverso e inclusivo em que todas as pessoas tenham oportunidades iguais para crescer e evoluir. Para chegar lá, nossas ações são voltadas para garantir:

Transformar a sociedade é um grande desafio. Mas, juntos, é possível. Faça parte de um grupo com o olhar para o futuro, mas que acredita que as transformações que queremos para o amanhã devem começar hoje.

description:

Location: Remote

Working Hours: 6 AM – 2 PM EST or at least 6 hours overlap within this window

About the Role

We’re seeking a detail-oriented and cost-conscious Purchasing / Sourcing Specialist to manage and optimize supplier relationships for our Amazon private-label and marketplace operations.

You’ll lead sourcing and negotiations with manufacturers, build landed cost models, and oversee end-to-end execution across samples, purchase orders, and logistics. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with operational rigor — ensuring smooth, margin-focused supply chain performance from factory to FBA/3PL.

  • Source, vet, and onboard manufacturers; run RFQs and negotiate pricing, MOQs, lead times, and payment terms.

  • Coordinate product samples, specifications, labeling, packaging, and compliance with Amazon and category standards.

  • 3+ years in purchasing, sourcing, or supply chain management, ideally within Amazon FBA or e-commerce.

  • Strong understanding of landed cost analysis, margins, and Amazon’s fee structures.
  • Knowledge of quality control checkpoints and product compliance.
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills; experience with PO or ERP systems preferred.

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Sobre a oportunidade:

Nosso cliente é uma health tech nacional em expansão, que integra tecnologia, inteligência de dados e cuidado domiciliar para transformar a experiência de saúde no país. A empresa está estruturando uma área de Dados moderna, cloud-native, escalável e 100% orientada à AWS.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados. Este(a) profissional será responsável por construir e operar os pipelines que sustentarão todo o ecossistema de dados da empresa, desde ingestão até transformações avançadas. É uma vaga para quem gosta de resolver desafios técnicos complexos, integrar diversas fontes e estruturar fluxos escaláveis para analytics, BI, produtos digitais e IA.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Construir, manter e otimizar pipelines de dados ponta a ponta (APIs, bancos, eventos, parceiros);
  • Desenvolver integrações de múltiplas fontes (25+ bancos PostgreSQL e MongoDB), priorizando eficiência, confiabilidade e escalabilidade;
  • Implementar transformações usando DBT, SQL e Python;
  • Orquestrar fluxos com Spark, Glue, Lambda, Step Functions ou equivalentes;
  • Configurar e otimizar processamento e armazenamento (S3, Athena, particionamento, compressão, DuckDB).
  • Monitorar qualidade, logs, métricas e observabilidade de dados;
  • Criar padrões internos de engenharia, qualidade e boas práticas (a área não possui padrões ainda);
  • Colaborar com a equipe de Plataforma e Ciência para viabilizar experimentação, modelos e produtos de dados.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência em engenharia de dados e construção de pipelines;
  • Domínio de AWS (Glue, S3, Athena, Lambda, IAM);
  • Forte conhecimento em SQL, Python e Spark;
  • Experiência com DBT e integrações de APIs;
  • Capacidade de balancear excelência técnica com entendimento do uso final dos dados (visão híbrida engenharia+produto);
  • Perfil orientado à performance, resiliência e entrega contínua.

Proposta de valor da oportunidade:

  • Participar da criação de toda fundação de engenharia de dados da empresa;
  • Autonomia para definir padrões, práticas e ferramentas;
  • Projetos com alto volume de dados clínicos, operacionais e financeiros;
  • Ambiente acelerado, colaborativo e orientado à experimentação.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant

Remote – Brazil

Company Overview

Sphise is a global outsourcing partner, helping international companies build and manage high-performing teams worldwide.

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Accountant to join their dynamic team.

Position Overview

As a Senior Accountant, you will play a critical role in ensuring financial accuracy and operational excellence across our international finance team. You will take ownership of complex reconciliations, advanced transaction coding, and key components of the month-end close, contributing directly to the integrity of our financial reporting.

Using your analytical mindset, technical expertise, and strong understanding of accounting principles, you will resolve discrepancies, support audits, guide junior staff, and help improve internal processes. Your ability to collaborate across departments, communicate clearly, and manage priorities will be essential as you handle AP/AR escalations, review expenses, and maintain high standards of compliance.

This position offers the opportunity to work in a structured, international environment with clear responsibilities, strong team collaboration, and room for continued professional growth.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Transaction Reconciliation: Perform and review complex transaction reconciliations in QuickBooks Online; identify and resolve discrepancies independently.
  2. Advanced Transaction Coding: Accurately classify and code complex transactions, including accruals, prepaids, and multi-department allocations in compliance with accounting standards.
  3. Financial Reporting Support: Assist in preparing monthly financial statements and supporting schedules; contribute to month-end close processes.
  4. Expense Management: Review and approve expense reports for accuracy and policy compliance; provide guidance to staff on expense procedures.
  5. Accounts Payable/Receivable: Handle escalated AP/AR issues, manage aging reports, assist with collection efforts, and maintain vendor relationships.
  6. Journal Entry Preparation: Prepare and post standard and adjusting journal entries; maintain supporting documentation.
  7. Process Improvement: Recommend improvements to accounting procedures and help implement best practices for efficiency.
  8. Audit Support: Prepare requested audit documentation and schedules; serve as a key contact for auditor inquiries.
  9. Junior Staff Support: Provide guidance and answer questions from junior accounting team members as needed.

Qualifications

  1. Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  2. Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  3. Solid understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.
  4. Excellent attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  5. Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  6. Strong communication skills for working with various departments and external contacts.

Preferred Experience

  1. 4-6 years of progressive accounting experience.
  2. Experience with month-end close processes and financial reporting.
  3. Background in small-to-mid-sized business accounting environments.
  4. Familiarity with expense management tools and multiple accounting software platforms.
  5. Experience training or mentoring junior staff members.

Benefits:

  1. Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  2. Flexible work environment.
  3. Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

Que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

– Atuar como ponto central entre time técnico, stakeholders e áreas de negócio no projeto de migração.

– Realizar levantamento, análise e mapeamento de requisitos funcionais e técnicos relacionados aos serviços e aplicações que serão migrados.

– Conduzir entrevistas, workshops e alinhamentos com áreas usuárias para entendimento dos processos atuais.

– Elaborar e manter documentação técnica, incluindo fluxos, diagramas, padrões de arquitetura, requisitos, regras de negócio e impactos da migração.

– Apoiar o time técnico definindo estratégias de migração, dependências, riscos e prioridades.

– Participar da definição e revisão de arquiteturas alvo, considerando boas práticas de AWS.

– Acompanhar o progresso das entregas, garantindo aderência ao escopo e acurácia das informações.

– Facilitar comunicação entre squads, engenharia e gestão do projeto.

– Atuar como referência técnica para direcionamento, tomada de decisão e esclarecimento de dúvidas.

Que você precisa ter

– Experiência prévia como BA, Tech Lead ou função híbrida em projetos complexos.

– Vivência com projetos de migração de cloud GCP → AWS.

– Conhecimento dos principais serviços de GCP (Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub etc.) e seus equivalentes na AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, SNS/SQS etc.).

– Capacidade de interpretar arquiteturas, integrações, APIs, bancos de dados e fluxos técnicos.

– Experiência com documentação funcional e técnica.

– Familiaridade com práticas de DevOps, automação e pipelines (desejável).

– Boa comunicação e habilidade para traduzir termos técnicos em linguagem de negócio.

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: MOTIVA I ANALISTA OPERAÇÕES INFRAESTRUTURA JUNIOR
description:
Descrição da vaga

Quer mover a sua carreira na Motiva?

A Motiva é o lugar certo para o seu talento, na qual você pode escolher o caminho que deseja seguir juntamente com uma empresa que promove a melhoria da qualidade de vida das pessoas por meio da mobilidade. Nos comprometemos em construir uma cultura cada vez mais diversa e valorizamos a inclusão de todas as pessoas independente de cor, etnia, religião, idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual ou deficiência, promovendo um ambiente inclusivo e com equidade de oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Monitorar e garantir a disponibilidade e o desempenho dos sistemas de infraestrutura tecnológica, assegurando que todos os componentes estejam operando de forma eficiente e sem interrupções;

Realizar a manutenção preventiva e corretiva dos equipamentos e sistemas de infraestrutura, identificando e solucionando problemas técnicos para evitar falhas e minimizar o tempo de inatividade. Implementar e gerenciar políticas de segurança da informação, incluindo a configuração de firewalls, antivírus e outros mecanismos de proteção, para assegurar a integridade e a confidencialidade dos dados;

Acompanhar e analisar métricas de desempenho dos sistemas de infraestrutura, gerando relatórios periódicos e propondo melhorias para otimizar a operação e reduzir custos;

Prestar suporte técnico aos usuários internos, solucionando dúvidas e problemas relacionados à infraestrutura tecnológica, garantindo um atendimento eficiente e de qualidade. Participar de projetos de expansão e atualização da infraestrutura tecnológica, colaborando com a equipe de projetos para implementar novas soluções e tecnologias;

Documentar procedimentos e processos relacionados à operação e manutenção da infraestrutura, criando manuais e guias para facilitar o treinamento e a consulta por parte da equipe. Realizar testes de contingência e recuperação de desastres, assegurando que os sistemas possam ser restaurados rapidamente em caso de falhas ou incidentes;

Colaborar com fornecedores e prestadores de serviços, gerenciando contratos e acompanhando a execução de atividades terceirizadas para garantir a qualidade e a conformidade com os requisitos da empresa;

Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências e inovações tecnológicas, participando de treinamentos e eventos do setor para aprimorar conhecimentos e habilidades.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você:

✅Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação, Sistema da Informação ou Engenharia de Redes;

✅Experiência com configuração e manutenção de equipamentos de rede (switches, roteadores);

✅Experiência com configuração e administração de redes privadas virtuais (VPNs);

✅Conhecimento de ferramentas de monitoramento de rede, como Zabbix ou Nagios;

✅Experiência com cabeamento estruturado, firewalls e práticas de segurança de redes;

✅Conhecimento em ferramentas de configuração e monitoramento de redes, como switches, roteadores e firewalls;

✅Familiaridade com protocolos como TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, VPNs, entre outros;

✅Conhecimentos em administração de sistemas operacionais (Windows Server, Linux), com ênfase na configuração de rede.

✅Conhecimento em serviços de conectividade de alta disponibilidade e redes WAN;

✅Capacidade de configurar, administrar e solucionar problemas de redes locais (LAN) e redes de longa distância (WAN), incluindo VPNs, roteamento e switching;

✅Capacidade de diagnosticar e resolver problemas de conectividade de rede;

✅Habilidade em criar relatórios claros sobre o status da conectividade e possíveis melhorias na infraestrutura.

Você se destaca, se tiver:

✅ Certificação em Redes ex.: Cisco CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate);

✅ Certificação ITIL Foundation;

✅ Certificação em Segurança de Redes ex.: CompTIA Security+ ou Fortinet NSE 1-3 para noções básicas de segurança de redes;

✅ Certificação em Cloud ex.: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner ou Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals.

Informações adicionais

Ao entrar para o nosso time integrado, você fará parte de uma empresa presente em 13 estados do país e que movimenta milhares de pessoas diariamente ao oferecer mobilidade de forma íntegra e que gera impacto positivo na sociedade. Aqui, você encontrará diversos benefícios para apoiar o seu desenvolvimento e dar mais movimento para a sua carreira.

title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required ⚠️

About Uitify

Uitify is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience;
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on cybersecurity trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.

Requirements

  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.

Why Join Us?

At Uitify, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

How to Apply

If you’re a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we’d love to hear from you. Please send your resume and portfolio to and
